title: Concrete Artinian polynomial localization for transcendental residue
statement: Let $D$ and $S$ be commutative local Artinian rings (each has a unique maximal ideal and every descending chain of ideals stabilizes), let $g:D\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism, and let $x\in S$. Regard $K=S/\mathfrak m_S$ as a field extension of $F=D/\mathfrak m_D$ using the residue-field embedding induced by $g$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Suppose $\operatorname{res}_S(x)$ is transcendental over $F$, meaning no nonzero polynomial over $F$ vanishes there [def-weil-algebraic-element]. Set $\theta:D[t]\to S$, $t\mapsto x$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and $P=\theta^{-1}(\mathfrak m_S)$. Let $T_0=D[t]_P$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $T$ be its canonical universe lift to $\mathrm{Type}(\max(u,v,z))$ if $D:\mathrm{Type}(u)$ and $S:\mathrm{Type}(v)$. Then $T$ is local Artinian, $D\to T$ is local and essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], and there exists a flat local map $g_1:T\to S$ factoring $g$, with $x\in g_1(T)$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Let $\theta:D[t]\to S$ evaluate $t$ at $x$. Locality gives $\mathfrak m_D[t]\subseteq P=\theta^{-1}(\mathfrak m_S)$. Reduction factors through $F[t]\to K$, evaluation at $\alpha=\operatorname{res}_S(x)$. Transcendence means this map is injective, so $P=\mathfrak m_D[t]$; this follows coefficientwise using $f\in\mathfrak m_D[t]$ iff every coefficient of $f$ lies in $\mathfrak m_D$. No injectivity of $\theta$ is needed.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: The polynomial ring $D[t]$ is Noetherian since $D$ is Artinian and thus Noetherian, and its localization $T_0=D[t]_P$ is Noetherian and local. Its maximal ideal is $PT_0=\mathfrak m_D T_0$, which is nilpotent. Therefore $T_0$ is Artinian. The map $D\to T_0$ is local. The polynomial algebra is smooth over $D$, hence $D\to T_0$ is essentially smooth.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: For $f\notin P$, $\theta(f)\notin\mathfrak m_S$ and is a unit. The localization universal property therefore extends $\theta$ to $g_0:T_0\to S$. The contracted maximal ideal is $PT_0$, making $g_0$ local. It factors $D\to S$ and sends $t/1$ to $x$, so $x\in g_0(T_0)$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: For $D\to T_0\to S$, the fibre $T_0/\mathfrak m_DT_0$ is the field $F(t)$. Apply the Noetherian fibre flatness criterion with $M=S$: $S$ is finite nonzero over itself and flat over $D$, while its fibre is a vector space over $F(t)$ and hence flat. This proves $g_0$ flat. The stated ring $T$ is the canonical universe lift of $T_0$; compose $g_0$ with its down ring equivalence and transport these properties. No witness of an unproved existence theorem is used to define the ring.

mathlib_searches.query: Localize a polynomial algebra over an Artinian local ring at the inverse image of the target maximal ideal when the residue of the variable is transcendental; the resulting local ring is Artinian and the evaluation map is flat
Polynomial localization over an Artinian local ring at the contraction of a target maximal ideal with a transcendental residue element is Artinian, essentially smooth, and evaluation is flat

lean.statement:
theorem artinian_transcendental_polynomial_localization
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    [Algebra D S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap D S)]
    (hflat : (algebraMap D S).Flat) (x : S)
    (hx : Transcendental (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D) (IsLocalRing.residue S x)) :
    let P : Ideal (Polynomial D) :=
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap D S) x)
    letI : P.IsPrime := inferInstance
    let T := ULift.{max u v z} (Localization.AtPrime P)
    IsLocalRing T ∧ IsArtinianRing T ∧ IsLocalHom (algebraMap D T) ∧ EssentiallySmooth D T ∧
      ∃ g' : T →+* S, IsLocalHom g' ∧ g'.Flat ∧
        g'.comp (algebraMap D T) = algebraMap D S ∧ x ∈ Set.range g'
